quests.title: Divine Ingenuity

dialogue.t: Hello there, Traveler. Great timing: we have a commission that I believe would best be taken up by you.
Well, it involves a hitherto unknown Domain.
Though the Guild has undertaken extensive investigations into that Domain, we have yet to achieve results of any particular value.
Honglang, who is in charge of this investigation, says that he needs the assistance of a highly adaptable adventurer.
You were the first person I thought of, Traveler.

dialogue.sit: What sort of Domain is this...

dialogue.t: Honglang is at the entrance to this Domain. If you're willing to help, you can go ask him what he needs.
We're counting on you, Traveler.
What's with this Domain...
Eh? You... Oh, so you're the one Ms. Katheryne called in?
I've heard that you're flexible, highly experienced, and one of our top adventurers to boot...

dialogue.sit: I guess you could say that...

dialogue.t: Wonderful! That's very reassuring indeed.

dialogue.sit: Still, could you tell me about this Domain...?

dialogue.t: Ah, yes, right. Sorry. Let me fill you in...
Well, here's what happened: some time back, a team of adventurers found this strange, large door out in the wild... You're looking at it right now, naturally.
Once they had passed through this gate, the team entered an unknown Domain.
According to the first batch of adventurers, the Domain was just an "empty room" when they first entered it.

dialogue.sit: One moment. What do you mean?

dialogue.t: I'm just giving an example. To be precise, it was an area "about 52 paces in length, 52 paces in breadth, and of unknown height."
For 52 paces either way, the area was an ordinary stone-tiled floor, but all the areas beyond were filled with a deep gray smoke.
Also, when someone tried to cross over the border into the area beyond the first 52 paces...
They would either mysteriously change direction and start walking the opposite way, or suddenly disappear and appear behind everyone else.
Whatever the case, it was impossible to cross this 52-pace area.

dialogue.sit: Did they try using any other tools to explore the place?

dialogue.t: They did, of course. But thrown objects would return to their original places, and even the light of torches could not penetrate further than 52 paces away.
So, you'd like our help in investigating this place?
That is the case. However... you won't just be doing "exploration."
I don't think it's possible to explain out here. Let's continue inside.
This...
You sure this is the same place as that "empty room" you talked about?

dialogue.sit: This just looks like a normal Domain...

dialogue.t: Exactly! Isn't this just an ordinary ruin? Y'know, the ones we visit all the time?
This is indeed the Domain we mean to explore.
And as for the reason why it looks like this...
That's because this Domain changed its form not long ago.
Eh?
That's right. This Domain transforms based on people's wishes.
According to the leader of the adventure team at that time, they'd started to lose patience with this place after exploring it for some time to no avail.
One of their members began to grumble under their breath.
"If this was an ordinary Domain, we would've finished exploring it long ago."
Hungry and tired as they were, the rest of the team expressed approval of that member's view.
And as more people began to concur, the team suddenly found themselves in "an ordinary Domain."
This "ordinary Domain" contained mechanisms, paths, treasure... even torches that were still burning.
The adventure team judged themselves unable to deal with such a situation, and thus reported back to the Guild immediately.
In response, we quickly sent people to conduct further investigations.
However, all we know even now is that this Domain can change according to a person's will.
If many people enter the Domain at once, then it will react to the person with the strongest thoughts.
Wow! Does this mean that it could create, say, the entire Liyue Harbor in here?
We've tried this, but to no avail. Perhaps our desire to create Liyue Harbor just wasn't strong enough.
Whatever the case, we are currently gathering adventurers to enter this Domain and cause all manner of changes according to their desires.
We hope that we might be able to figure out some of the rules and principles behind the changes this Domain undergoes, and thus get answers from there.

dialogue.sit: In that case, how should I operate this place?
Is there some special method to all this?

dialogue.t: Well, you see that mechanism over there? That's a "trigger" that we put in place. One of our adventurers dreamed this one up, in fact.
In simple terms, his desire was "to be able to change this Domain only when we touch this mechanism."
The Domain answered these wishes, but to ensure that this mechanism remains here, we have to periodically invite him back...

dialogue.sit: Huh, to think that you could do something like that...

dialogue.t: If not for some of these contingencies, this Domain would keep changing all the time...

But if you look at it from a different angle, this Domain really is quite suited to training adventurers. I mean, just one thought, and all sorts of mechanisms and terrain can emerge in a blink of an eye!
Well, talk is cheap, though... So why don't you give it a go yourself?
See that golden "Adventure Coin" over there? That's a little something we created using our willpower as well.
Try getting ahold of that coin, would you?
Try getting ahold of that coin, would you?
Wow! That was pretty impressive. You got the hang of this place really quickly!
In that case, we're counting on you. Use all your wits and imagination to transform this Domain.
I do hope that we'll be able to understand the rules behind the changes of this Domain soon.

quests.description: Katheryne of the Liyue Harbor Adventurers’ Guild seems to be looking for you…
